newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroder raises Valero EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Schroder raises Valero EPS.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim has raised Valero Corp's second quarter and fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimates by $0.10 to $0.50 and $1.85 respectively.

-- Valero closed the acquisition of the Basis refineries on May 1 and had been projecting an operating contribution of $47 million from these assets this year, but the company yesterday indicated that the contribution would be about $20 million for the quarter due to the strength of Gulf Coast refining margins, which have been at or above the five year range for the past two months.

-- "In the past two weeks Valero has dropped about nine percent. There have been no negative company developments and, in fact, the ongoing strength in Gulf coast margins and the better than expected contribution from the Basis acquisition should enhance the investment case," said analysts Michael Mayer and Philip Tendler.
-- Schroder rates the stock outperform and has a target price of $42 for Valero which was trading up 1/4 at 35-1/4.
